key_decisions.decision: Preserves the wives’ and children’s expulsion and the speaker’s appeal to authority; notes ambiguity in my lord versus the Lord.
Makes both coercive penalties and the three-day deadline explicit.
Retains confession, commanded separation, and the wives as the actual people affected.
Retains the named opposition and support while noting that the Hebrew can also describe involvement in the matter.
Preserves the selected panel, named appointments, and starting date without making Ezra the sole selector.
Keeps the pledge, actual wives, and guilt offering without euphemizing the separation.
Preserves both Malchijah entries and makes the repeated name readable rather than deleting it.
Retains the second Bani heading as written rather than inserting a different family name.
Retains Bani and Binnui as listed names without inserting a new family heading absent from the source.
Uses the contextual sense of the difficult closing clause while explicitly noting its uncertain Hebrew and not claiming an unambiguous completed expulsion.
